caption: Rest the pointer on a reply: the words that carry a technique are marked, and the window names it. (Reading lens, with Every reading technique on.)
The thread panel: how many accounts it read, and the frames the thread repeats, counted across posts and authors.
Rest the pointer on a link: who owns the site, its owner type and its fact-check record, in the fact-checkers' own words.
On any Mastodon server you turn it on for: join dates, coordination and language signs beside each reply.
YouTube comments: when each comment was posted and how it was received, beside the comment, with coordination and language signs when they appear.
